list.name: contributor
list.label: Contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT contributor FROM whodunit_repos WHERE contributor <> ''

options.content:
## Adoption by contributor
*Who is using an agent, how much, and how much of it survives into the codebase.*

Measured from git history and the agent's own session records on each developer's machine. Nothing is self-reported.

**Seats are not visible here.** Vendor billing knows who holds a licence; whodunit only knows machines it is installed on, so it cannot report a seat nobody used. Adoption is measured against people who committed, not against seats purchased.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.status='assisted' AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.title: Adoption

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) v
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.description: Share of this contributor's commits carrying an attribution trailer.

panels.title: Lines kept

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(c.lines_added) v FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE c.status='assisted' AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.description: Lines in assisted commits — what reached the repository, not what the agent proposed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=s.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.title: Active days

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000))) v
FROM whodunit_events e JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=e.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.description: Days with any recorded agent activity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(s.tool_calls) v FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=s.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

options.content:
**This replaces a vendor acceptance rate, and measures something stronger.**

A tool-acceptance rate counts clicks: did the developer accept the suggestion in the moment. It cannot see what happened next.

`intersected` means the agent's exact lines were still in the diff at commit time. `observed` means the agent edited the file but its text had changed before committing — accepted, then rewritten. Both are real work; the split is how much survived contact with review.

A healthy mix is not 100% intersected. Editing the agent's output is normal engineering.

panels.title: Evidence strength

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE c.method
         WHEN 'intersected' THEN 'intersected — the agent''s lines survived'
         WHEN 'observed'    THEN 'observed — edited before committing'
         WHEN 'declared'    THEN 'declared — stated, not measured'
         WHEN 'inferred'    THEN 'inferred — from surrounding evidence'
         ELSE 'undetermined — no evidence either way'
       END AS `method`, COUNT(*) AS `commits`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY c.method ORDER BY `commits` DESC

panels.description: 'undetermined' means whodunit could not tell — never that no AI was used.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000), '$grain') AS `bucket`,
       COUNT(*) AS `file edits`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.session) AS `sessions`
FROM whodunit_events e JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=e.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY `bucket` ORDER BY `bucket`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000), '$grain') AS `bucket`,
       SUM(e.lines_added) AS `lines added`,
       SUM(e.lines_removed) AS `lines removed`
FROM whodunit_events e JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=e.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY `bucket` ORDER BY `bucket`

panels.title: Contributors

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.contributor AS `contributor`,
       COUNT(*) AS `commits`,
       SUM(c.status='assisted') AS `assisted`,
       ROUND(SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS `adoption %`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.method='intersected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `intersected`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN c.lines_added ELSE 0 END) AS `lines kept`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=c.repo_id
WHERE r.contributor <> '' AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY r.contributor ORDER BY `assisted` DESC

panels.description: Every contributor with commits in range, ignoring the filter above so the whole team stays comparable. Adoption is a fact about measured commits, not a target.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000)) AS `day`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.session) AS `sessions`,
       COUNT(*) AS `file edits`,
       SUM(e.lines_added) AS `lines added`,
       SUM(e.lines_removed) AS `lines removed`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.tool) AS `tools used`
FROM whodunit_events e JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=e.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('$contributor'='__all__' OR r.contributor='$contributor') AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY `day` ORDER BY `day` DESC
